artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let p > 3 be a prime. Prove or disprove the following congruences.

(i) If p ≡ 7 (mod 12) and p = x² + 3y² with x, y ∈ ℤ and y ≡ 1 (mod 4), then
    Σ_{k=0}^{p-1} C(2k,k)² / (−16)^k  ≡  (−1)^{(p−3)/4} · ( 4y − p/(3y) )   (mod p²),
and
    Σ_{k=0}^{p-1} k · C(2k,k)² / (−16)^k  ≡  (−1)^{(p+1)/4} · y   (mod p²),
where C(2k,k) is the central binomial coefficient and the fraction p/(3y) is interpreted modulo p².

(ii) If p ≡ 1 (mod 12), then
    Σ_{k=0}^{p-1} C(p−1,k) · C(2k,k)² · 16^k  ≡  0   (mod p²).

(For reference, the Pell sequence {P_n}_{n≥0} and its companion {Q_n}_{n≥0} are defined by P_0 = 0, P_1 = 1, P_{n+1} = 2P_n + P_{n−1}, and Q_0 = 2, Q_1 = 2, Q_{n+1} = 2Q_n + Q_{n−1}.)
artifact.status_search_result: A search did not turn up a published proof or disproof of this specific conjecture (A56) on supercongruences for sums Σ C(2k,k)²/(−16)^k modulo p² involving the representation p = x² + 3y². The conjecture appears in Z.-W. Sun's compilation of open congruence conjectures, where Part A conjectures are listed as still unresolved, but no clear status update for this particular item was found.

status_evidence.snippet: Part A consists of 100 unsolved conjectures; Part B contains conjectures recently confirmed.
status_evidence.claim: Conjectures of type A (including A56) are listed as unsolved in the maintained compilation.

status_evidence.title: On a Supercongruence Conjecture of Z.-W. Sun
status_evidence.snippet: Recent paper proving certain Sun supercongruence conjectures, but not this specific one.
status_evidence.claim: Some of Sun's supercongruence conjectures have been resolved, but no proof of this particular A56 was located.
